canDoYue: 你識講嚟觀光同住幾多日，仲識申報禮物同貨物。
canDoEn: Say you are visiting for tourism and how long you will stay, then declare a gift and your goods.

dialogue.speaker: pat
dialogue.text: Good morning. What is the main purpose of your visit today, and are you here for tourism?
dialogue.glossYue: 早晨。你今日嚟嘅主要目的係咩？你係咪嚟觀光？
dialogue.say: Good morning. What is the main purpose of your visit today, and are you here for tourism?

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: I am visiting for tourism, and I'm staying for five days at a hotel in the city.
dialogue.glossYue: 我嚟觀光，會喺市區一間酒店住五日。
dialogue.say: I am visiting for tourism, and I'm staying for five days at a hotel in the city.

dialogue.speaker: pat
dialogue.text: Are you here for business as well, and do you have a return ticket in your bag?
dialogue.glossYue: 你係咪亦都有公差？你袋入面有冇回程機票？
dialogue.say: Are you here for business as well, and do you have a return ticket in your bag?

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: This trip is not for business, and my return ticket shows the fifth day of the stay.
dialogue.glossYue: 呢趟唔係公差，回程機票寫住逗留嘅第五日。
dialogue.say: This trip is not for business, and my return ticket shows the fifth day of the stay.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: I declare these goods at the desk, and this small gift is for a friend at home.
dialogue.glossYue: 我喺櫃檯申報呢啲貨物，呢份細禮物係送畀屋企朋友。
dialogue.say: I declare these goods at the desk, and this small gift is for a friend at home.

dialogue.speaker: pat
dialogue.text: Please complete this short form for me here, and tell me if you have nothing to declare.
dialogue.glossYue: 請你喺度填好呢張短表格，再話我知你係咪冇嘢申報。
dialogue.say: Please complete this short form for me here, and tell me if you have nothing to declare.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: I have nothing to declare apart from this small gift, and the goods are for personal use.
dialogue.glossYue: 除咗呢份細禮物，我冇嘢申報，貨物係自己用。
dialogue.say: I have nothing to declare apart from this small gift, and the goods are for personal use.

dialogue.speaker: pat
dialogue.text: The officer will stamp your form here, and you may go on to the hotel after that.
dialogue.glossYue: 關員會喺度幫你張表格蓋章，之後你可以去酒店。
dialogue.say: The officer will stamp your form here, and you may go on to the hotel after that.
